question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is '**Gallary**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous spelling is **Gallary**
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word and an example.
 
• **Gallery**: a room or building for the display or sale of works of art.
 
 
• Example:* Mukundan was excited about the first exhibition of his paintings in the **gallery***.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• गैलरी : प्रदर्शनी लगाने का स्थान
 
• **Example**: *Sandhya was a manager in an art* ***gallery***__
